value:
Imported 3 eligible sequences; retained 66 capture/sequence exclusions.

Regional, temporal and stereo measurements are diagnostics pending blinded review of original pixels. No colour-quality winner, neural-detail verdict or production default has been selected. See private/exclusions.json and private/analysis.json for coverage and provenance.

hostProvenance.limitation: Recorded version/process matching does not prove the loaded host DLL hash; exact enabled-provider verification is separate.

metrics.baseline: sequence means; separate frames retained; no RGB scalar ranking
metrics.contrast: mean3x3 encoded-luma RMS contrast; regional standard deviation retained separately
metrics.luminance: fixed IEC sRGB decode then same coefficients, relative 0..1
metrics.motionScreen: gradient presence/sign disagreement at >=2 code values; conservative confound screen, no registration

temporalSampling.limitation: Temporal conclusions cover the sampled acquisition cadence only. Sparse or irregular captures can alias or miss HMD frame-rate flicker; neither reviewer agreement nor low sampled variance proves frame-rate stability.

untestedConditions: conversion profiles lack established insertion input-range/domain evidence; not admitted on appearance alone

Temporal conclusions cover the sampled acquisition cadence only. Sparse or irregular captures can alias or miss HMD frame-rate flicker; neither reviewer agreement nor low sampled variance proves frame-rate stability.
exposure recovery under a deliberate illumination challenge unless documented in campaign evidence

value.warning: Frames are dependent samples. Motion/exposure/animation may explain variation; no causal colour verdict follows.

value.interpretation: baseline animation/exposure drift and regional variation; no candidate ranking

limitations: Only fixed regional crops at f01, f06 and f12 were supplied; full frames and intermediate ordinals were not inspected.
No actual sample timestamps or cadence were supplied. This review cannot assess HMD frame-rate flicker or exposure-recovery duration.
Visible stability does not verify subpixel camera/geometry stability or exact alignment. No image metrics, registration, hashes or metadata were consulted.
Tone changes are visible; their cause is uncertain. Scene illumination, exposure and other rendering effects cannot be separated from these crops alone.
No moving occlusion is apparent within the reviewed regions; movement or occlusion outside them is untested.
No candidate mode, source-to-candidate colour fidelity, colour-domain contract, production default or mode preference was inferred.
Assessment concerns the supplied image evidence only, not physical display, lens or binocular comfort.

objectiveRankings.stereoConsistency: indeterminate as a mode ranking; no obvious one-eye-only change in these sparse crops
objectiveRankings.temporalStability: indeterminate as a mode ranking; baseline tone variability is visibly present
objectiveRankings.usefulNeuralDetail: indeterminate: unchanged baselines do not establish candidate reconstruction quality

observations.geometry: Eyes, nose, mouth, hair and beard boundaries retain their visible positions across the supplied ordinals and repeats. No gross pose change or new occluder is evident.
observations.tone: The f01 face is visibly brighter than later ordinals in each repeat; cheeks, nose, beard and eye-socket shading become darker. The overall warm scene cast persists.

observations.geometry: Embroidery, trim and neckline retain their visible layout; no material boundary is visibly displaced or newly occluded.
observations.tone: The f01 cloth/trim is brighter than later ordinals, with darker brown fabric and less prominent embroidery highlights thereafter.

observations.geometry: Necklace strands, ornament outlines and garment edges retain their visible arrangement.
observations.tone: Gold/brown ornament highlights and adjacent clothing darken between f01 and the later samples in all three repeats.

observations.geometry: Wood silhouette, grain and adjacent board lines remain visibly stationary.
observations.tone: This region looks comparatively stable. Any small tone variation is less evident than the character-region darkening; visual inspection does not establish pixel equality.

observations.geometry: Stone texture landmarks and the central dark vertical band remain in the same visible positions.
observations.tone: Stone brightness varies without a corresponding obvious shape change. The clearest example is s1 f06 being darker than s1 f01 and f12. The wall does not show the same simple early-to-late darkening pattern as the character crops.

observations.geometry: Eyes, nose, mouth, hair and beard boundaries retain their visible positions across the supplied ordinals and repeats. No gross pose change or new occluder is evident.
observations.tone: The f01 face is visibly brighter than later ordinals in each repeat; cheeks, nose, beard and eye-socket shading become darker. The overall warm scene cast persists.

observations.geometry: Embroidery, trim and neckline retain their visible layout; no material boundary is visibly displaced or newly occluded.
observations.tone: The f01 cloth/trim is brighter than later ordinals, with darker brown fabric and less prominent embroidery highlights thereafter.

observations.geometry: Necklace strands, ornament outlines and garment edges retain their visible arrangement.
observations.tone: Gold/brown ornament highlights and adjacent clothing darken between f01 and the later samples in all three repeats.

observations.geometry: The curved wood boundary, grain and dark lower area remain visibly stationary.
observations.tone: This region looks comparatively stable. Any small tone variation is less evident than the character-region darkening; visual inspection does not establish pixel equality.

observations.geometry: Stone texture landmarks and the dark vertical strip at the left edge retain their visible positions; the strip does not appear as a new moving occluder.
observations.tone: Stone brightness varies without a corresponding obvious shape change. The clearest example is s1 f06 being darker than s1 f01 and f12. The wall does not show the same simple early-to-late darkening pattern as the character crops.

scope.inspection: All supplied crops viewed individually at original resolution with view_image; no transformations.

stereoAssessment.conclusion: No obvious unilateral colour jump or structural divergence is visible. Expected left/right viewpoint differences, particularly in wood and clothing, are not treated as defects.
stereoAssessment.left: Character tone darkening and wall-tone fluctuation are visible while geometry appears stationary.
stereoAssessment.right: Independently inspected right-eye crops show the same broad findings.

verdict.admissibility: Any later comparison must retain and account for the observed baseline variation. These images alone do not establish that matched ordinals from different sets are exposure/illumination matched.
verdict.fixedPixelColour: Confounded as a time-invariant colour reference: unchanged repeats show visible regional tone variation. Cross-ordinal colour differences cannot be attributed to a candidate effect.
verdict.fixedPixelGeometry: No visible gross displacement or moving occlusion in the supplied crops; exact pixel alignment is unverified.

import sys,json,copy
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(sys.argv[1]); checkout=Path(sys.argv[2])
sys.path.insert(0,str(checkout/"tools/nr-color"))
import hmd_assess as h, hmd_capture as c
def payload(name): return json.loads(h.read_json(root/(name+".json"))["content"][0]["text"])
manifest=h.read_json(Path(payload("scout4Get")["result"]["manifest"]["finalPath"]))
scene=payload("fixedSceneCurrent")
acq=manifest["children"][0]["actual"]["acquisition"]
fingerprint="dragonsreach-fixedpose-20260916T1100-fov095-character-mask"
region_defs=[
 ("face","skin","Exposed cheek, forehead, eyes and nose; hair/beard edge retained",[1400,895,200,180],[865,895,200,180]),
 ("cloth","material","Patterned upper tunic",[1430,1130,105,110],[915,1130,105,110]),
 ("wood_shadow","shadow","Shadowed throne wood beside the seated figure",[830,1700,100,120],[300,1700,100,120]),
 ("necklace","highlight","Metal necklace highlights over dark tunic",[1490,1190,85,80],[970,1190,85,80]),
 ("stone_wall","background","Stone wall outside the character mask",[620,1000,150,120],[130,1000,150,120])]
policy={"schemaVersion":1,"sceneFingerprint":fingerprint,"motionGradientMismatchLimit":0.15,"eyes":{}}
for i,eye in enumerate(h.EYES):
 policy["eyes"][eye]={"nativeSize":[2468,2740],"regions":[{"id":r[0],"class":r[1],"description":r[2],"rect":r[3+i]} for r in region_defs],"unavailable":{}}
camera={k:acq["cameraEvidence"][k] for k in ("view","projection","positionAdjust")}
camera.update(viewTolerance=0.000001,projectionTolerance=0.000001,positionAdjustTolerance=0.00001)
original=payload("fixed-nr095")["neuralRendering"]["requestedConfiguration"]
fixed=copy.deepcopy(original["upscaling"]);fixed.pop("neuralRenderingEnabled")
candidates=[{"condition":kind,"settings":{"settings":{"appearanceMix":0.0,"detailStrength":1.0,"maximumDetailStops":1.0}}} for kind in ("nr_off","raw","managed_identity","preserve_source")]
spec={"sceneFingerprint":fingerprint,"fixedScene":{"cameraEvidence":camera,"recordingScene":{"cell":scene["cell"]["editorId"],"cellFormID":int(scene["cell"]["formId"],16),"interior":True,"weatherFormID":int(scene["weather"]["formId"],16)},"gameHour":scene["gameHour"],"gameHourTolerance":0.01,"entryPoint":payload("scout4RecordStop")["meta"]["entryPoint"],"timeScale":0,"originalTimeScale":20},"fixedSettings":fixed,"candidates":candidates,"intervalMs":500,"untestedConditions":["conversion profiles lack established insertion input-range/domain evidence; not admitted on appearance alone","deliberate illumination-change exposure recovery","general NR","FOV-only NR","physical display/lens behaviour","HMD frame-rate flicker"]}
plan=h.make_plan(spec,policy,19417);c.validate_plan(plan);c.validate_fixed_scene(plan["fixedScene"])
for name,obj in (("regions",policy),("spec",spec),("private-plan",plan)):h.save_json(root/(name+".json"),obj)
host_path=Path("D:/Skyrim Mods/mods/Devbench/SKSE/Plugins/devbench.dll")
host=h.preserve(host_path,root/"provenance/devbench.dll")
receipt={"state":payload("state"),"mappedModules":h.read_json(root/"mappedModules.json"),"physicalModulePathVerified":True}
h.save_json(root/"provenance/host-identity.json",receipt)
rp=root/"provenance/host-identity.json"
host.update(buildIdentity={"version":payload("state")["version"],"sourceCommit":"7f60c2bf787d5da9efdec9b5a18ecb9a68035b4b"},runtimeMatched=True,observedVersion=payload("state")["version"],observedPid=28724,physicalModulePathVerified=True,identityReceipt={"path":str(rp),"bytes":rp.stat().st_size,"sha256":h.digest(rp)})
index={"schema":"csx-nr-hmd-capture-v1","planPath":str(root/"private-plan.json"),"planSha256":h.digest(root/"private-plan.json"),"sceneFingerprint":fingerprint,"fixedSettings":fixed,"producer":manifest["producer"],"devbench":host,"sessionId":manifest["sessionId"],"sequences":[],"performanceCampaign":False,"complete":False,"userSessionAuthorization":h.read_json(root/"user-session-authorization.json"),"untestedConditions":plan["untestedConditions"]}
h.save_json(root/"campaign-index.json",index)
settings={}
for key,candidate in plan["candidateMapping"].items():
 settings[key]=c.candidate_colour(c.colour_editable(original["color"]),candidate)
h.save_json(root/"candidate-configurations.json",settings)
h.preserve(Path("D:/Skyrim Mods/mods/Synthesis Patch (SFW)/SKSE/Plugins/devbench/recordings/recording_1789556396805.json"),root/"scout/recording.json")
print(json.dumps({"planPath":str(root/"private-plan.json"),"planSha256":index["planSha256"],"schedule":plan["schedule"],"candidateConfigurations":settings,"plan":plan}))

g=h.read_json(r/'baseline-repeatability-gate.json')
i.update(complete=False,baselineRepeatabilityQualified=False,terminalReason='unchanged baseline stability gate failed; no colour candidates dispatched')
for n in range(4,70):i['sequences'].append({'scheduleOrdinal':n,'notRunReason':i['terminalReason']})
assess.atomic_json(r/'campaign-index.json',i)
result=h.analyse(r/'campaign-index.json',r/'analysis')
h.save_json(r/'analysis-result.json',result)
print(json.dumps({k:result[k] for k in ['sequencesAccepted','captureExclusions','motionConfoundedRegions','unavailableExposureSamples','temporalSampling']}))
